AUTHORITY: Actual bounded adoption evidence separate from proposed rule
EXISTENCE: Pinned bytes/native identity available; not applicability
INVALIDATION_RELEVANCE: Exact source-to-effect relationship; not membership merely because outcome desirable
NECESSITY: Declared proof support versus target satisfaction across alternatives; missing qualification standard remains
OPERATIVE_SUPPORT: Explicit native accepted relationship; not every metadata association

SOURCE_ROLE_DISTINCTIONS.CONFIGURATION_SOURCE: Explicit installation/currentness prerequisite can be operative dependency but is not automatically a proof tuple member
SOURCE_ROLE_DISTINCTIONS.PROVENANCE_SOURCE: Metadata-only when incidental; own proof provenance has an explicit native validation withdrawal rule
SOURCE_ROLE_DISTINCTIONS.QUALIFICATION_INVALIDATION_TARGET: Only adopted exact coverage predicate may establish membership
SOURCE_ROLE_DISTINCTIONS.REQUIRED_OPERATIVE_SOURCE: Requires exact operative and necessity predicates
